name: Twinroof
summary: A smart-home app for one household with two homes: a city flat and a hill house
about: A complete smart-home app for a family that lives between a flat in the city and a house in the hills, drawn in bold flat blocks with thick ink outlines. Switch homes and the drawn houses slide past each other while the whole palette morphs from coral to teal. Travel mode locks one home and warms up the other step by step, and Compare puts energy, bills and temperatures side by side in rupees. Good for a smart-home or second-home product, in cream or ink.
how: Use the City flat and Hill house switch at the top: the houses slide and every colour in the app changes
On Both homes, flip lights, cooling and heaters straight from each home card
Press Travel here: watch each step tick as one home locks up and the other heats up and lights the way
In This home, dim lights and set each room's cooling or heating, or lock up and switch everything off
Compare energy per day (7D or 30D), monthly bills and inside temperatures for both homes
Lock both homes and watch four live cameras in Security; move people and tick tasks for the caretaker in Household
